item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01060","case1_error":"Doubles the second country's stay for the third, instead of assigning both other countries twice the first country's stay.","case2_error":"Uses four 30-minute intervals per hour instead of two, doubling article production.","reason":"The first changes the comparison baseline; the second uses an incorrect time conversion.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01061","case1_error":"Calculates gas cost directly from miles times dollars per gallon, omitting division by miles per gallon.","case2_error":"Correctly calculates three additional hours, then answers with six total hours as though they were additional.","reason":"The first omits a required rate conversion; the second answers the wrong requested quantity after correctly calculating it.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01062","case1_error":"Omits Saturday's ten additional rounds, undercounting the weekend by 300 minutes.","case2_error":"Multiplies already annual spending by 52 again; also incorrectly evaluates 468 × 52 as 24,576 instead of 24,336.","reason":"Omitting an explicitly stated contribution differs from applying an annualization factor twice, with an additional arithmetic error.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01063","case1_error":"Counts five complete lists; the wording ambiguously places the successful fifth-video selection within or after those five rounds.","case2_error":"Treats three claws per leg as per parrot, then subtracts four claws instead of adding the single extra claw.","reason":"The first question ambiguously describes the final round, preventing a firm diagnosis. The second clearly mishandles the exceptional parrot's contribution.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01064","case1_error":"Forms incorrect population ratios, using 2/19 beavers per human and its reciprocal as moose per human.","case2_error":"Correctly writes 12 + 6 − 1 + 5 − 2 but evaluates it as 18 instead of 20.","reason":"The first uses erroneous ratio relations; the second numerically evaluates a correctly written expression incorrectly.","judgment":"different"}]}
